title: A call walks the gateway checks
goal: {{cast.agent}} makes a call and it should reach {{cast.app}} only if every check passes.
obstacle: Without a fixed order of checks, a refusal could come from any layer and nobody could say which.
control: {{cast.gateway}} runs the same five checks in the same order on every call.

steps.title: Key and scope
steps.tell: {{cast.agent}} sends {{cast.key}} as a Bearer key. {{cast.gateway}} looks it up and checks the scope for the surface being called.
steps.say: An unknown, revoked or expired key gets 401. A missing scope gets 403.

steps.title: Grant and limits
steps.tell: {{cast.gateway}} checks that {{cast.app}} is granted and that the call is within its rate and budget limits.
steps.say: A bare 403 here usually means the grant is missing. A hit limit returns 429 with a retry-after header.

steps.title: Guardrail
steps.tell: {{cast.gateway}} lets the guardrail on {{cast.key}} screen the text, and a call that passes reaches {{cast.app}}.
steps.say: A block returns 400 content_blocked. The guardrail is set on the key, not on the app.
